description: This file defines the BuzzCommentDecorator class, which serves as a decorator for the BuzzComment entity within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It manages additional behaviors such as setting related entities, formatting dates, and managing likes, leveraging various traits and entity references.

classes.name: BuzzCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the BuzzComment entity, providing methods to manipulate comments, set related entities, format timestamps, and handle like interactions in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a BuzzComment entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the comment by employee number.

methods.name: setShareById
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare entity with the comment by share ID.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the comment formatted as Y-m-d.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time of the comment formatted as H:i.

methods.name: isAuthEmployeeLiked
methods.description: Checks if the authenticated employee has liked the comment.

methods.name: increaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Increments the number of likes on the comment by one.

methods.name: decreaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Decrements the number of likes on the comment by one.
